request   GET https://files.example.com/private/a.txt
actor     research/agent
decision  audit
reason    no_route: the host is claimed for the actor and no route matches the method and path
policy    files-audit (the first policy claiming the host; none allowed the request)
audit     allowed only because every policy claiming the host for this actor is in Audit mode; Enforce would deny it
